sheets.title: The title row — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Folder, name and type were three controls in one grey. They are now one row under one rule, with the folder first and the type last in the accent ink.

sheets.title: A path typed in the name — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The slash finishes a folder: `./Work/Taxes/` typed at the start of the name moves into the folder segment as it is typed, and only the leaf stays in the name.

sheets.title: The folder list — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Typing `wo` in the folder narrows its list to the folder that matches, with the best match highlighted. The last row, `+ wo/`, makes a new folder and is never what Enter takes by default.
sheets.before: native select: a platform menu that cannot be typed into

sheets.title: The type list — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The type is chosen from the types this installation offers and nothing else. `.s` narrows the list to `.secret`; text that matches no row is put back when the field is left.
sheets.before: native select sized to its widest option, 104px
sheets.after: combobox sized to its text, 87px, listing only real types
